sub: Control the Jutyar app without a new release: which versions may still be used, maintenance, a message on every phone, which features are on, and the limits.
note: The app reads these settings from the backend each time it opens. Until the backend is connected they are kept here and do not reach phones yet.
latest_v_sub: Phones on an older version see "A new version is ready".
min_v_sub: Older phones are asked to update and cannot send until they do.
features_sub: Switched off, the button disappears from the app and a short note explains why. Farmers' data is kept.
f_add_farm_sub: Farmers can register a new farm.
f_walk_mode_sub: Mark the corners by walking with the phone (GPS).
f_satellite_sub: The satellite picture under the farm.
f_doctor_sub: Questions with photos to the AI Doctor.
f_reports_sub: Farmers report a problem (disease, hail, fire, flood).
f_alwa_sub: Farmers put crops on sale. Not published yet.
f_plan_sub: The weekly plan from the weather planner.
f_push_sub: Alerts and warnings as phone notifications.
maint_on_sub: The app shows the message below and only works offline.
maint_live: Maintenance is on: farmers see the message and cannot send anything.
announce_on_sub: A banner at the top of the app's home screen, for every farmer.
l_dunam_sub: Bigger outlines are refused before sending.
l_gps_sub: Worse points ask the farmer to wait.
help_phone_sub: Farmers call it from the app.
limit_positive: Every limit must be more than 0.
corners_bad: Fewest corners must be at least 3 and less than most corners.
